channel.title: Strands Agents Blog
channel.description: Tutorials, architecture deep-dives, and production insights from the Strands Agents team.

item.title: Strands Box: The Big Picture
item.description: Strands Box, now in developer preview, is an open source local sandbox for AI agents that pairs operating-system isolation with Dogwood semantic policy. Here's why semantic policy matters, and how Box's design follows from it.

item.title: Bidi Agents now GA
item.description: The easiest way to create voice agents with direct support for Amazon Nova Sonic, OpenAI, and Gemini models.

item.title: Introducing Strands Decider 2B: a small, open source, decision model
item.description: Strands Decider 2B is a small, open source, decision model optimized for fast experimentation, local development, and innovation.

item.title: Introducing Strands harness: frontier performance with 28% lower token cost
item.description: Strands harness is a fully assembled, customizable, state-of-the-art agent you run locally or deploy anywhere.

item.title: Framework-agnostic evaluation with Strands Evals
item.description: Strands Evals supports agents built with Claude Agents SDK, OpenAI Agents, Google ADK, and more. Learn how it achieves compatibility with other frameworks and how you can begin writing cross-framework experiments.

item.title: Strands Team AI Usage Reflection
item.description: A reflection on the impact that AI has had on the strands agents team, our thoughts about it, and how we intend to address the issues we are facing.

item.title: Our production SDK hit 99.95% on ARC-AGI-3
item.description: Strands Agents scored 99.95% on ARC-AGI-3 using the same minimal harness that developers ship to production every day

item.title: Robots working together: connecting agents to the physical world with Strands Robots and the Model Hardware Standard
item.description: How Strands Robots lets agents read from and act on many robots and devices at once, across Zenoh, AWS IoT, and the new Model Hardware Standard (MHS), in simulation and the real world.

item.title: Figma to Code at Scale: Building with Strands Agents
item.description: A team at Amazon Ads built a multi-agent system that converts Figma designs into production ad layouts. Here's what their architecture looks like, why they chose Strands, and the lessons they learned shipping it.

item.title: Hackathon Challenge: automate the one task you keep putting off
item.description: Pick the recurring chore you never quite get to and hand it to an agent. It is harder, and more interesting, than a cron job. There is also $40K in it.

item.title: Introducing Harness Optimizer: Automatically optimize your agent harness
item.description: Harness Optimizer is an open-source library that optimizes the context around your LLM agent (system prompt, tool docs, skills) the way you'd train a model: rollouts in, rewards out, parameters updated.

item.title: Reduced cost, better isolation, and more resilience: Strands Agents evolves next-gen capabilities
item.description: Strands Agents ships context management that cuts costs in half, Strands Shell for sandboxed agent execution, and chaos testing and red teaming in Strands Evals 1.0.

item.title: Inside Agentic Football Cup: 10 Strands Agents, 1 Second to Decide
item.description: How we use Strands Agents and the model-driven approach to run 5v5 autonomous football matches inside a 4-hour developer workshop, with a hard latency contract, structured outputs, and multi-agent coordination.

item.title: Multimodal evaluators: MLLM-as-a-judge for image-to-text tasks in Strands Evals
item.description: Announcing four new MLLM-as-a-Judge evaluators for image-to-text tasks in Strands Evals: Overall Quality, Correctness, Faithfulness, and Instruction Following — automated, image-grounded scoring with reasoning.

item.title: What We Learned from One Year of Building Production Agents
item.description: Strands Agents turned one year old. Here are the key lessons our engineers learned after open sourcing this framework and hitting 25 million downloads.

item.title: Introducing Strands Agents TypeScript 1.0: Build Production Agents in TypeScript
item.description: Version 1.0 of the Strands Agents TypeScript SDK is here. Build type-safe AI agents with full model provider support, custom tools, plugins, and multi-agent orchestration in Node.js and the browser.

item.title: The Strands Agents Community Has a New Home
item.description: The Strands Agents Discord server is live. A place for builders to get real-time help, share what they've built, and connect with the Strands team.

item.title: ToolSimulator: scalable tool testing for AI agents
item.description: ToolSimulator is an LLM-powered framework within Strands Evals that enables safe, scalable agent testing by using simulated tool responses instead of risky live API calls.

item.title: Strands Agents TypeScript SDK: Build AI Agents in TypeScript
item.description: The Strands Agents TypeScript SDK brings the model-driven approach to the TypeScript ecosystem. Build type-safe AI agents that run in Node.js and the browser.

item.title: Simulate realistic users to evaluate multi-turn AI agents in Strands Evals
item.description: ActorSimulator in the Strands Evals SDK enables teams to test conversational agents through realistic, goal-driven simulated users rather than relying on static test cases or manual testing.

item.title: Evaluating AI agents for production: A practical guide to Strands Evals
item.description: Learn how to systematically evaluate AI agents using Strands Evals, covering core concepts like cases, experiments, evaluators, multi-turn simulation capabilities, and practical integration patterns for production deployment.

item.title: How Steering Hooks Achieved 100% Agent Accuracy Where Prompts and Workflows Failed
item.description: Steering hooks achieved a 100% accuracy pass rate across 600 evaluation runs, compared to 82.5% for simple prompt-based instructions and 80.8% for graph-based workflows.

item.title: Runtime Guardrails for Strands Agents with Agent Control
item.description: Define what your Strands agents can and can't do at runtime, without changing a line of agent code.

item.title: Introducing Strands Labs: Get hands-on today with state-of-the-art, experimental approaches to agentic development
item.description: Strands Labs is a new GitHub organization designed to give developers the ability to get hands-on with experimental, state-of-the-art approaches to agentic AI development.

item.title: Building intelligent physical AI: From edge to cloud with Strands Agents, Bedrock AgentCore, Claude 4.5, NVIDIA GR00T, and Hugging Face LeRobot
item.description: Learn how to build physical AI systems that combine edge computing with cloud intelligence using Strands Agents, NVIDIA GR00T, and Hugging Face LeRobot.

item.title: Introducing Strands Agent SOPs – Natural Language Workflows for AI Agents
item.description: Agent SOPs are a standardized markdown format for defining AI agent workflows in natural language that balances flexibility and control.

item.title: Strands Agents and the Model-Driven Approach
item.description: Learn how the model-driven approach in Strands Agents SDK lets modern LLMs drive their own behavior, making agents more resilient and adaptable.

item.title: Introducing Strands Agents 1.0: Production-Ready Multi-Agent Orchestration Made Simple
item.description: Strands Agents 1.0 brings multi-agent patterns, A2A protocol support, and production-ready features to the open source SDK.

item.title: Using Strands Agents with Claude 4 Interleaved Thinking
item.description: Learn how to use Claude 4's interleaved thinking beta feature with Strands Agents for faster, more fluid reasoning and reduced tool calls.

item.title: Introducing Strands Agents, an Open Source AI Agents SDK
item.description: Strands Agents is an open source SDK that takes a model-driven approach to building and running AI agents in just a few lines of code.
